text:
asha: quick sync - proposing 'ingest-light, verify-deferred' pattern: ingest runs a tiny prefilter (tokenization hash, shape check, 30-item probe) and returns a candidate_id. heavy bench runs in verification pool async. agree?

tom: yes. couple constraints: candidate must not be eligible for routing until verification finishes or explicit override. we need clear state names and TTLs.

yuri: suggest states: submitted -> prefilter_ok -> queued_verify -> verifying -> shadowing -> canary -> promoted | quarantined | rejected. include a 'stale' terminal for long-pending jobs.

asha: for golden sets, plan is to record golden_id + probe_hash in candidate metadata at ingest time. bench must echo golden_id in webhook so we can detect mismatches. runtime refuses promotion if golden_id missing.

bench-bot: bench scheduled: candidate=cand-1771239999, est_gpu_hours=2.4, expected_done=~6h; webhook=/hooks/bench/result.

tom: intake response should include candidate_id, prefilter_outcome, golden_probe_id, and bench_eta. also expose a short smoke_summary (tokenization_issues:bool, sample_failures:int).

yuri: on bench result format keep it compact: candidate_id, verdict(pass|warn|fail), failed_tests[], drift_score, p95_ms, golden_id, bench_run_id, summary_url. example: {candidate_id:"cand-1771239999",verdict:"warn",failed_tests:["regression:qa3"],drift_score:"0.18",p95_ms:"290",golden_id:"gold-2026-03-x",bench_run_id:"b-1234",summary_url:"https://bench/r/b-1234"}

asha: behavior mapping: pass -> schedule shadowing; warn -> quarantined_pending_owner_action and notify owner; fail -> immediate quarantine and if any traffic routed then auto-rollback + incident. allow owner to request rebench with a different golden_id.

tom: ops rules: org_gpu_daily_quota, per_candidate_gpu_cap, bench_queue_ttl (default 48h), and a priority queue. if quota exhausted intake should mark candidate 'queued_manual' and require human approval.

oncall: add runbook: if bench job stuck > bench_queue_ttl -> mark stale, notify owner, escalate to oncall if high-priority org. also provide a manual re-enqueue button.

asha: rollout recipe: post-pass do shadowing (24h collection, no responses), then tiny canary (0.05% for 30m), then 0.5% for 2h, 2% for 4h, then promote. bench can veto anytime.

yuri: metrics to emit: time_in_state, bench_queue_latency, quarantines_by_org, smoke_false_reject_rate, post_promotion_regressions. surface current bench spend in console and block new intake if org near quota.

bench-bot: bench update posted: candidate=cand-1771239999, verdict=pass, bench_run_id=b-1234, summary_url=https://bench/r/b-1234

asha: great, i'll draft the RFC with state machine diagram, ingest/bench contracts, TTLs and console UX. tom/yuri can review.
tom: I'll review the state machine.
yuri: I'll mock the webhook handler and the golden_probe tooling.
